summary: The Wizard-selected throne effect 5 reaches sit.c:take_gold, but JavaScript only records an unported gap. C walks the hero inventory, removes each coin stack through remove_worn_item and delobj, prints the no-gold or gold-lost message, and refreshes the status. The missing deletion also skips delobj_core’s obj_resists rn2(100), which is why the saved RNG first diverges before the throne’s later rn2(3). The owner is the whole take_gold function and its throne caller.

source.branch: On a normal throne when the effect roll leads to Wizard selection of effect 5, throne_sit_effect calls take_gold. take_gold saves each next inventory link before deleting COIN_CLASS objects, calls remove_worn_item then delobj for each, and reports either a strange sensation (none found) or no gold with disp.botl set. The throne then continues to its possible disappearance roll.
callers: sit.c:throne_sit_effect case 5 at lines 102-104 calls take_gold; js/sit.js:throne_sit_effect case 5 currently only calls note_unported.
dependencies: steal.c:remove_worn_item is called even for unworn coins; preserve the ordinary no-worn behavior.
invent.c:delobj and delobj_core are already ported and consume zap.c:obj_resists(obj,0,0), including rn2(100) for ordinary coins; pass the runtime environment and preserve the inventory next pointer.
The final no-gold status refresh uses disp.botl and source messages, and throne_sit_effect continues its post-effect rn2(3) only after take_gold returns.

evidence: Saved v10 evaluation challenges/evaluations/20260928083103-v10.json matches 30/31 screens but at step 30 C calls rn2(100)=26 in obj_resists(zap.c:1469) while JavaScript instead calls rn2(3)=1. Recording SHA-256 is 104c9d2525500bd1a6df5ae10067c1a0886574b02fb832f4272dbab623b0f793.

Upstream nethack-c/upstream/src/sit.c:14-35 defines take_gold, and sit.c:102-104 invokes it for throne effect 5. Upstream invent.c:1435-1462 delobj_core calls obj_resists; zap.c:1458-1475 draws rn2(100) for ordinary objects.

js/sit.js:250-253 skips case 5 with note_unported; js/invent.js:3400 and :3426 already export delobj and its source object-resistance call. The independent recipe wishes two gold pieces, sits on a normal throne, and selects effect 5.
